license: Catalog annotations and these files: MIT. Linked resources, papers, data and weights keep their own terms.
description: Curated resources other than papers: models, datasets, benchmarks, agents, frameworks, infrastructure, tools, products, publishers and learning resources.

items.name: AndroidControl
items.summary: Android demonstrations with high-level goals, step instructions, screenshots, and accessibility trees.

items.name: Android in the Wild
items.summary: Human demonstrations of Android tasks with screenshots and touch actions.

items.name: WebEvolver code component
items.summary: Component for web-agent trajectory collection, supervised-data preparation and world-model-based trajectory synthesis.

items.name: Mobile-Agent-E code component
items.summary: Android automation component with hierarchical planning, reflection and persistent tips/shortcuts learned across task sequences.

items.name: PC-Agent (X-PLUG component)
items.summary: Multi-agent desktop automation component for Windows and macOS, combining active perception, task decomposition and reflection for workflows spanning applications.

items.name: OpenAgents Web Agent
items.summary: The OpenAgents browser-control component, connecting a Chrome extension to a web agent and local chat platform for navigating sites and completing interface tasks.

items.name: BrowserTrace
items.summary: Local, cloud-free replay debugger that records each Browser Use step's screenshot, URL, action and model I/O as a timeline and reports the step at which a failed run diverges from a known-good one.

items.name: MoTIF
items.summary: Mobile task demonstrations and natural-language instructions.

items.name: AppSim-Bench
items.summary: Simulated mobile applications and evaluation tooling for reproducible GUI-agent tasks with controlled application state.

items.name: Agent Infra Sandbox
items.summary: Sandbox environments supporting computer and browser interaction.

items.name: AgentDesk
items.summary: Desktop environments that AI agents control programmatically, run locally with Docker or remotely on Kubernetes, built on the agentd REST daemon and offering a coordinate-grid overlay for LMM input.

items.name: Surfkit
items.summary: Python toolkit and CLI for building, publishing and running multimodal agents that operate devices such as Ubuntu desktops, locally or on Kubernetes, with task trackers and an agent hub.

items.name: SPA-Bench
items.summary: 340 single-app and cross-app tasks over 66 Chinese and English Android apps, with plug-in support for 11 smartphone agents and automatic coarse-to-fine success detection.

items.name: StateAct
items.summary: State-tracking prompts and experiment runners for language agents, including a WebShop implementation alongside text-based environments.

items.name: AdvAgent (formerly AdvWeb)
items.summary: Research code for constructing and evaluating adversarial inputs to web agents, with a black-box red-team pipeline using Mind2Web data and SeeAct.

items.name: VisionTasker
items.summary: An Android automation implementation that translates screenshot-based UI understanding into language descriptions for step-by-step LLM planning and action execution.

items.name: UI-Ins
items.summary: Treats grounding instructions as multiple reasoning perspectives, releasing a data pipeline, training code and UI-Ins-7B and 32B models trained by SFT on synthesized instructions, then RL.

items.name: RoTS
items.summary: Announced GUI trajectory synthesis resources for recovery from policy-induced errors; the inspected repository marks code and data releases as in preparation.

items.name: MobileAgent (Alipay)
items.summary: Mobile-control research implementation combining operating-procedure context with human interaction for personalized task execution.

items.name: COLA demo
items.summary: Research demonstration of collaborative Windows GUI automation with dynamic task scheduling and recovery mechanisms.

items.name: Proposer-Agent-Evaluator (PAE)
items.summary: A browser-agent training system that proposes tasks, collects visual interaction trajectories, and uses automated evaluation to drive policy improvement.

items.name: AndroidArena
items.summary: Android environment for evaluating language-model-driven agents.

items.name: Activity Recorder
items.summary: Windows tray utility that records primary-display screenshots, keyboard key codes and mouse events as local JPEG and JSON files for training-data collection.

items.name: GUIHalluBench
items.summary: Measures hallucination in UI-element parsing by matching the boxes and descriptions a model lists for 1,000 English and 1,000 Chinese screenshots against human annotations.

items.name: Go-Browse
items.summary: Structured website-exploration and data-processing code that revisits discovered pages, proposes tasks and collects trajectories for web-agent fine-tuning.

items.name: Appium
items.summary: Open-source WebDriver-based automation server for mobile, desktop and IoT apps, extended by per-platform drivers for iOS, Android, macOS and Windows, plugins, and clients in Java, Python, Ruby and C#.

items.name: Ferret-UI
items.summary: Screen understanding research within the Ferret model family.

items.name: Aria-UI
items.summary: Mixture-of-experts GUI grounding model with 3.9B activated parameters that can use text or interleaved image history, with released training data and an AndroidWorld agent.

items.name: PyAutoGUI
items.summary: Cross-platform Python module for scripted mouse and keyboard control, message boxes and screenshots with on-screen image search, working on the primary monitor under Windows, macOS and Linux.

items.name: Cradle
items.summary: Framework in which foundation models control games and software from screenshots alone, acting through keyboard and mouse, shown on RDR2, Stardew Valley, Cities: Skylines and Dealer's Life 2.

items.name: SheetCopilot
items.summary: Spreadsheet automation agent for Windows/Excel, with benchmark assets and a separately released headless Ubuntu evaluation backend.

items.name: Browser Use
items.summary: Open-source browser agent library that runs locally with any LLM against a local or cloud browser, and also serves as a CLI for coding agents and as a driver for Claude's browser toolset.

items.name: Browser Use WebUI
items.summary: A Gradio interface for configuring and running Browser Use agents, including persistent browser sessions and interaction recordings.

items.name: Stagehand
items.summary: Browser automation framework combining code and natural-language actions.

items.name: BrowserOS / BrowserOS neo
items.summary: Chromium-based browser implementations for external agent control and built-in assistant workflows, with session visibility and replay facilities.

items.name: Bytebot
items.summary: Open-source desktop agent that works inside its own Ubuntu Linux virtual desktop, with a web task interface, REST APIs for tasks and direct control, a takeover mode and password-manager logins.

items.name: Agent-R
items.summary: Trajectory collection and revision utilities that use tree search and model-guided critique to train agents to recover from mistakes, including WebShop tasks.

items.name: GUI-ReWalk
items.summary: A desktop trajectory-generation framework that moves from stochastic GUI exploration to inferred goals and multi-stage task completion, with retrospective reasoning annotations.

items.name: UI-TARS
items.summary: Native GUI agent models; UI-TARS-1.5 adds reinforcement-learned reasoning before acting and an open 7B checkpoint, and UI-TARS-2 extends to games, code and tool use.

items.name: UI-TARS Desktop
items.summary: Desktop app for a local GUI agent driven by UI-TARS and Seed-1.5-VL/1.6 models, offering local and remote operators for computers and browsers; the repository also ships the Agent TARS CLI and web UI.

items.name: AUITestAgent
items.summary: Generates mobile GUI interactions from natural-language test requirements and checks application behavior against those requirements.

items.name: CAAP Agent
items.summary: Screenshot-driven agent implementation for MiniWoB++ and WebShop, using a visual observer and context-aware prompts to issue mouse and keyboard actions.

items.name: CRAB
items.summary: Cross-environment benchmark framework for multimodal agents.

items.name: Web Context Bench (Python)
items.summary: Local-page benchmark comparing six browser representations on token use, factual reading and target-element selection, with deterministic answer scoring.

items.name: WinDOM code
items.summary: GUI-grounding training and evaluation code with same-family distillation, GRPO recipes and point-in-box scoring, using a Windows-style web environment.

items.name: Adversarial Web Agents
items.summary: Evaluation resources for adversarial attacks on multimodal web agents.

items.name: GUI-Robust
items.summary: Evaluation scripts and linked data for comparing GUI action predictions and task execution under ordinary and anomalous interface conditions.

items.name: Work2Skill
items.summary: Collects human GUI demonstrations and inspects multimodal evidence to derive reusable agent workflow skills.

items.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
items.summary: MCP tools for browser control and inspection through Chrome DevTools.

items.name: WebGames
items.summary: 150 client-side web challenges in five capability domains, built to be easy for humans but hard for browsing agents, each revealing a password when solved.

items.name: Auto-GUI / Auto-UI
items.summary: Screenshot-based mobile agent implementation with training and inference code for chain-of-action prediction.

items.name: Windows-MCP
items.summary: A Windows MCP bridge exposing application, window, keyboard and mouse operations plus native UI-state inspection for agents.

items.name: AndroTMem inference and evaluation code
items.summary: A public Android GUI evaluation framework with action-history, summary and anchored-memory prompt modes, plus step-action and dependency-aware task scoring.

items.name: Digi-Q
items.summary: Offline device-control training code that learns action values and uses them to select promising actions, with linked trajectories and checkpoints.

items.name: DigiRL
items.summary: Reinforcement learning for autonomous mobile device control.

items.name: DistRL
items.summary: Distributed online reinforcement-learning framework for Android agents, with environment setup and trajectory collection tools.

items.name: SwitchMem
items.summary: Memory-routing implementation that chooses text or image demonstrations for a frozen GUI actor, with offline evaluation and Android transfer experiments.

items.name: GUI-World
items.summary: GUI video benchmark and training data covering six scenarios, from Android and iOS to websites and XR, with eight question types for image and video LLMs and the GUI-Vid model.

items.name: Mobile Harness
items.summary: Portable agent instructions and integration tooling for local or cloud phone control through mobilerun-core.

items.name: Mobilerun (formerly Droidrun)
items.summary: A framework that combines screenshots and accessibility state with agent tools for mobile-device tasks through command-line and Python interfaces.

items.name: Mobilerun Portal (formerly Droidrun Portal)
items.summary: An Android accessibility service that exposes UI-element inspection, device-control interfaces and screen feedback to mobile automation agents.

items.name: E2B Desktop
items.summary: Open-source, isolated Linux Xfce desktop sandboxes for computer-use agents, driven from Python or JavaScript SDKs with screen streaming, mouse, keyboard and window control, screenshots and shell.

items.name: Agent E
items.summary: Browser automation agent on the AG2 framework that pairs a planner agent with a browser navigation agent to fill forms, search shops and work through sites, also callable over a local HTTP API.

items.name: UI-Genie
items.summary: Training and evaluation code for a mobile-agent framework that iteratively generates trajectories using agent and reward-model feedback.

items.name: AgentDAM
items.summary: Web-agent benchmark for measuring unnecessary use of sensitive personal information during end-to-end task execution.

items.name: OpenApps
items.summary: Configurable browser apps and task rewards for testing computer-use agents under changes in content, layout and appearance.

items.name: STEVE / STEVE-R1 research code
items.summary: Research code and linked models for step-verified computer-use training; the current repository describes STEVE-R1 and its trajectory releases.

items.name: MiniWoB++
items.summary: Over 100 web-interaction environments extending OpenAI's MiniWoB, controlled from Python through a Gymnasium API that drives the browser with Selenium.

items.name: MobileGPT
items.summary: An Android client and Python-server agent that learns reusable app subtasks through exploration, selection, derivation and memory recall.

items.name: WebTestBench
items.summary: An end-to-end web-testing benchmark where agents derive test checklists from development instructions, interact with deployed applications and report functional or constraint-related defects.

items.name: PC-Agent
items.summary: Human-cognition-transfer framework for PC agents: PC Tracker logs human computer use, cognition completion turns logs into cognitive trajectories, and a planner works with a grounding agent.

items.name: PC-Agent-E training and deployment
items.summary: Tools for refining and augmenting human computer-use trajectories, preparing supervised training data, and deploying a native PC-Agent-E scaffold.

items.name: WindowsAgentArena-V2
items.summary: Windows benchmark revision with task/evaluator fixes and VM-initialization support, documented alongside PC-Agent-E.

items.name: GUI-HARVEST
items.summary: Optimizes GUI-agent execution code from repeated rollout evidence and checks proposed changes against fixed validation gates.

items.name: VideoCAD training and evaluation code
items.summary: VideoCADFormer training, action-log preprocessing and evaluation code for learning CAD interface action sequences from screen recordings of browser-based Onshape.

items.name: AndroidEnv
items.summary: Android device-control platform with screenshots, accessibility telemetry, input actions, and an optional reinforcement-learning task interface.

items.name: Screen2Words
items.summary: Mobile screen descriptions for language-based screen understanding.

items.name: ScreenQA
items.summary: About 86,000 human-written question-answer pairs over 35,000 Rico mobile screenshots, plus ScreenQA Short and ComplexQA variants, for benchmarking screen content understanding.

items.name: UIBert AppSim and RefExp annotations
items.summary: Two Rico-derived UI component retrieval datasets: AppSim pairs semantically similar elements across screens, while RefExp links referring expressions to target elements.

items.name: UICrit
items.summary: Mobile-interface critiques and quality ratings with region coordinates and RICO screen references, including a larger three-annotator release than the original paper dataset.

items.name: AndroidWorld
items.summary: Android environment with programmatic task evaluation for mobile agents.

items.name: PPTC
items.summary: PowerPoint creation and editing benchmark with API-based execution and checks of the resulting presentation files.

items.name: WONDERBREAD
items.summary: An offline benchmark of workflow documentation, quality assessment and knowledge transfer using human web-navigation demonstrations, action traces and written procedures.

items.name: TAG attention-driven GUI grounding
items.summary: Grounding and evaluation code that aggregates a pretrained vision-language model’s attention maps to localize requested interface elements without fine-tuning.

items.name: WindowsWorld
items.summary: Cross-application Windows benchmark with intermediate task evaluation.

items.name: HUD
items.summary: SDK for RL environments and evals spanning coding, browser, computer-use and robotics agents, whose environments expose SSH, MCP, CDP or VNC capabilities behind a minimal start-and-grade protocol.

items.name: ScreenSuite
items.summary: A shared evaluation harness for GUI-model perception, offline action prediction and multi-step interaction, using simple smolagents-based agents across existing benchmarks.

items.name: HyperAgent
items.summary: Library adding natural-language commands to Playwright: accessibility-tree single actions, multi-step tasks that can use screenshots, an MCP client and action caching for replay without LLM calls.

items.name: WebCanvas
items.summary: Framework and evaluation resources for real-world web agents.

items.name: CoAT research implementation
items.summary: Research scripts that generate screen descriptions, action reasoning and expected outcomes, then predict Android GUI actions using the resulting Chain-of-Action-Thought context.

items.name: UI-Venus
items.summary: GUI agent model family; UI-Venus-2, at 9B and 27B, acts on mobile, web and desktop in one end-to-end agent, trained with keypoint-based multi-judge task verification.

items.name: InfiGUI-G1
items.summary: InfiGUI-G1 3B and 7B grounding models trained with Adaptive Exploration Policy Optimization, which samples several candidate answers per pass under an adaptive exploration reward.

items.name: MobileWorldBench
items.summary: Benchmark of semantic world modeling for mobile agents, with question-answering tasks and GPT-judged generation tasks, plus training data built on AitW and AndroidControl screens.

items.name: Seg2Click
items.summary: Training and inference implementation that predicts an executable-region mask and derives a GUI click from that mask.

items.name: MacAgentBench
items.summary: 676 macOS tasks across 25 applications, each run in its own Docker container and scored by deterministic rule-based checks with multiple checkpoints.

items.name: ARPO training framework
items.summary: Replay-based policy-optimization framework for GUI agents, with distributed OSWorld rollouts and screenshot/action histories.

items.name: B-MoCA
items.summary: Mobile control benchmark with varied interface configurations.

items.name: MobileSafetyBench
items.summary: Android emulator testbed that scores mobile device-control agents on both safety and helpfulness, using ADB and Appium for observations, actions and success checks.

items.name: UI-AGILE
items.summary: GUI agent trained by RL with a continuous reward, a simple-thinking reward and cropping-based resampling on about 9k samples, plus a plug-in decomposed grounding-and-selection inference method.

items.name: MemGUI-Agent
items.summary: MemGUI-Agent training and offline evaluation tools provide trajectory conversion, LoRA SFT templates, and step-level checks of GUI actions, memory updates and context folding.

items.name: MobileForge
items.summary: Android GUI-agent adaptation framework combining app exploration, generated curricula and rollout feedback with hint-conditioned step-level GRPO; the documented public training path targets Qwen3-VL-8B.

items.name: Web-Shepherd inference and evaluation
items.summary: Process-reward inference and benchmark-evaluation utilities that use task checklists to assess individual web-agent decisions.

items.name: AppAgent Pro
items.summary: Proactive Android agent built on AppAgent that uses GPT-4o to decide whether YouTube or Amazon content would help, operates those apps over ADB, and merges what it finds into its answer.

items.name: LaVague
items.summary: Open-source web agent framework where a World Model turns an objective and the current page into instructions and an Action Engine compiles them into Selenium or Playwright code to run.

items.name: LearnAct
items.summary: Released inference and evaluation code for demonstration-conditioned mobile GUI agents on LearnGUI-Offline. The repository describes a multi-agent adaptation method and links the LearnGUI demonstrations.

items.name: ScreenSpot Pro
items.summary: GUI grounding benchmark focused on professional high-resolution interfaces.

items.name: iOSWorld
items.summary: Native iPhone-simulator benchmark with shared user data, application workflows, agent runners, and rubric-based scoring.

items.name: LlamaTouch
items.summary: Mobile UI task evaluation using application state information.

items.name: UI-R1
items.summary: Rule-based reinforcement learning for GUI action prediction, releasing UI-R1-3B, trained from Qwen2.5-VL-3B, the efficiency-oriented UI-R1-E-3B, and training data.

items.name: Synapse
items.summary: A computer-control research implementation that retrieves example trajectories from memory, abstracts task-relevant state and prompts an agent to navigate browser tasks.

items.name: ColorBench
items.summary: A graph-based mobile GUI benchmark that evaluates long tasks through screenshot states and multiple valid or erroneous transitions, including reflection, replanning and backtracking.

items.name: Mobile Use
items.summary: Android GUI agent that operates real phones through ADB with hierarchical reflection and a multi-agent framework, run from a web interface or Python and evaluated on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab.

items.name: Self-MAP
items.summary: A conversational web-agent implementation with candidate ranking and memory-assisted action planning, including optional memory simplification, refinement and self-reflection modules.

items.name: AgentRewardBench
items.summary: A benchmark and evaluation toolkit for comparing automatic web-agent judges against expert judgments of task success, side effects and repetition.

items.name: SafeArena
items.summary: Web-agent benchmark pairing benign and harmful tasks to study deliberate misuse risks.

items.name: WebLINX
items.summary: Demonstrations and evaluation for conversational web navigation.

items.name: WebLlama
items.summary: Training, evaluation and integration tooling for dialogue-guided web agents, including Llama fine-tuning workflows and BrowserGym examples built around WebLINX.

items.name: EvoCUA
items.summary: Computer-use model and training resources from the EvoCUA project.

items.name: Fara
items.summary: Microsoft browser-use agent models that act from screenshots by predicting click coordinates without accessibility trees; Fara1.5 comes in 4B, 9B and 27B, succeeding Fara-7B.

items.name: GUI-Actor
items.summary: GUI grounding model with attention-based action localization.

items.name: VEM GUI-Agent-RL
items.summary: Training code that learns a value environment model from offline Android interaction data and uses its frozen value estimates to guide GUI policy optimization.

items.name: MagenticLite / Magentic UI
items.summary: Microsoft agent application combining orchestration with browser interaction; successor to Magentic UI.

items.name: Magma
items.summary: Microsoft foundation model for multimodal agents, pretrained with Set-of-Mark and Trace-of-Mark objectives on UI, robotics and video data and fine-tunable for web and mobile UI navigation.

items.name: OmniParser
items.summary: Screenshot parser that detects interactable regions and captions icons so vision-language models can ground actions, released as V1.5 and V2 weights alongside OmniTool for driving a Windows 11 VM.

items.name: Phi-Ground
items.summary: Microsoft GUI grounding models from an empirical study of grounding training, from data collection to model training, released as Phi-Ground-4B-7C with evaluation code.

items.name: Playwright
items.summary: Browser automation library used as an execution layer by agents.

items.name: Playwright MCP
items.summary: MCP server that lets LLM clients drive Playwright browsers through structured accessibility snapshots instead of screenshots, with opt-in vision, PDF and devtools capabilities.

items.name: Precision CUA Bench
items.summary: Evaluation resources for pixel-precise cursor grounding in code editors.

items.name: Set of Mark
items.summary: Visual-prompting toolbox that labels image regions for multimodal reference and grounding, including GUI applications.

items.name: UFO
items.summary: Windows agent framework for application and desktop automation.

items.name: CUAWright (formerly Webwright)
items.summary: Agent framework for browser and desktop tasks using automation code.

items.name: Windows Agent Arena
items.summary: Windows 11 benchmark for multimodal desktop agents in a reproducible VM that runs locally or in parallel on Azure ML, with a harder mode where agents must set tasks up themselves.

items.name: WebVoyager
items.summary: Multimodal web navigation agent and evaluation tasks on real websites.

items.name: Mobile Next MCP
items.summary: An MCP server exposing mobile accessibility snapshots, screenshots and device interactions across real devices, simulators and emulators.

items.name: MobileAgentBench
items.summary: Automated benchmark for mobile LLM agents whose default tasks use ten Simple Mobile Tools Android apps, installed as a Python library that detects task completion.

items.name: AgentProg
items.summary: Android GUI-agent framework that keeps long-running task context in structured programs, variables and control flow, with a CLI and AndroidWorld integration.

items.name: AutoDroid
items.summary: LLM-powered Android task automation built on DroidBot, released with DroidTask, a dataset of per-app screenshots, view hierarchies, exploration records and ground-truth task files.

items.name: AutoDroid V2
items.summary: An Android automation implementation that builds app documentation from exploration traces and evaluates language-model-generated execution code in emulator workflows.

items.name: NNetNav
items.summary: Collects and labels browser-exploration trajectories for agent training, with code for data processing, fine-tuning, and web evaluation.

items.name: Nanobrowser
items.summary: A browser-extension agent that reads pages, interacts with elements and moves between tabs from a side-panel task interface.

items.name: MultiUI
items.summary: 7.3 million training samples built from webpage UIs and structured with enhanced accessibility trees, for text-rich visual understanding, released with UIX-Qwen2 models.

items.name: WorkForceAgent-R1
items.summary: Web-task reward functions, WorkArena data processing and GRPO training configurations for reasoning-oriented language agents.

items.name: ScreenAgent
items.summary: Environment and agent in which a vision-language model controls real desktops over VNC with mouse and keyboard in plan, act and reflect stages, plus a hand-annotated dataset of daily computer tasks.

items.name: SeeClick
items.summary: GUI grounding model trained to locate visual interface elements.

items.name: Notte
items.summary: Web agent framework and cloud SDKs for managed Chrome sessions, adding a CLI, an MCP server for coding agents, serverless browser functions and an API that builds automations from English tasks.

items.name: Nut.js
items.summary: Desktop automation library for keyboard, mouse, and screen interaction.

items.name: OculiX (SikuliX continuation)
items.summary: A maintained continuation of SikuliX that locates on-screen targets with image matching and OCR, drives desktop or Android interfaces, and exposes scripting and optional MCP interfaces.

items.name: Lumen browser agent
items.summary: A screenshot-driven browser agent over Chrome DevTools Protocol, with resumable sessions, context compression, action replay and configurable completion checks.

items.name: MMBench-GUI
items.summary: Four-level GUI-agent benchmark across six platforms, from content understanding and element grounding to task automation and collaboration, scored with an efficiency-quality area metric.

items.name: OpenAdapt
items.summary: Tools for learning and automating workflows from desktop demonstrations.

items.name: Universe legacy GUI interaction client
items.summary: An archived Gym-compatible client that exposes screen observations and keyboard/mouse actions over VNC for remote application and browser environments, including the historical World of Bits integration.

items.name: AgentCPM-GUI
items.summary: 8B on-device smartphone agent built on MiniCPM-V that operates Chinese and English apps from screenshots, trained with reinforcement fine-tuning and a compact JSON action space.

items.name: MobA
items.summary: An Android agent that combines global task planning and memory with a local action executor, using reflection to revise mobile interaction steps.

items.name: GUI-Odyssey
items.summary: Human-demonstrated Android episodes for cross-app navigation, spanning six task types, 212 apps and about 1,400 app combinations, for training and evaluating agents.

items.name: ScaleCUA
items.summary: Computer-use model family trained with cross-platform interaction data.

items.name: ZeroGUI
items.summary: Online RL framework for GUI agents in which VLMs generate the training tasks and judge success from trajectory screenshots, with OSWorld and AndroidLab checkpoints trained from UI-TARS-7B-DPO.

items.name: Open Interpreter
items.summary: Assistant framework combining code execution and computer interaction.

items.name: MobileGym++ / MobileGym++ Bench
items.summary: Browser-rendered mobile simulation with resettable app state and a shared task suite for GUI-only and GUI-plus-tool agents.

items.name: OpenMobile-2 code
items.summary: Evaluation adapters and training guidance for OpenMobile-2 across Android emulators and browser-rendered mobile simulation.

items.name: OS-Atlas
items.summary: OS-Atlas GUI action models, including grounding bases fine-tuned from InternVL2-4B and Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct that accept any image size and output 0-1000 relative coordinates.

items.name: OS-Copilot
items.summary: Open-source library for generalist agents acting on an operating system's web, terminals, files and third-party apps, with the FRIDAY assistant, which takes custom tools and self-learns Excel tasks.

items.name: OS-Genesis
items.summary: Interaction-driven pipeline that synthesizes mobile and web GUI agent trajectories without human supervision or predefined tasks, via reverse task synthesis and a trajectory reward model.

items.name: OS-Map
items.summary: An OSWorld-derived desktop benchmark with an Ubuntu virtual-machine environment and expanded task configurations for measuring breadth and depth of computer interaction.

items.name: OS-Sentinel
items.summary: Safety-checking environment and benchmark for mobile agents on AndroidWorld that judges proposed actions with rule-based and VLM-based checks, evaluated on the MobileRisk trajectory dataset.

items.name: ScienceBoard
items.summary: Scientific-workflow tasks for multimodal agents in desktop software such as ChimeraX, KAlgebra, Celestia, Grass GIS and Lean 4, with apps modified to expose state for evaluation.

items.name: EIA
items.summary: Evaluation suite for Environmental Injection Attacks that embed invisible malicious HTML elements into benign websites to test privacy leakage in generalist web agents.

items.name: Mind2Web
items.summary: Human demonstrations and tasks for generalist web navigation research.

items.name: Mind2Web 2
items.summary: Long-horizon agentic web search benchmark whose Agent-as-a-Judge framework scores time-varying, citation-backed answers, with evaluation scripts for its dev and test sets.

items.name: Online Mind2Web
items.summary: 300 tasks on 136 live websites for evaluating web agents online, with outdated tasks replaced over time, human-reviewed submissions and the WebJudge automatic evaluator.

items.name: RedTeamCUA
items.summary: A controlled testing framework that combines desktop virtual machines and replicated websites to evaluate computer-use agents against indirect prompt injection.

items.name: SeeAct
items.summary: Generalist web agent framework for large multimodal models such as GPT-4V, with a Playwright tool that runs agents on live websites, text-choice and set-of-mark grounding, and a crawler mode.

items.name: SkillWeaver
items.summary: A web-agent framework that explores sites, synthesizes reusable interaction APIs and builds a skill library for later tasks.

items.name: UGround
items.summary: Code, training data and weights for universal visual grounding of GUI elements from screenshots, including Qwen2-VL-based UGround-V1 at 2B, 7B and 72B and offline and online evaluation suites.

items.name: WebDreamer
items.summary: World-model and planning components that simulate web-action outcomes, with linked training data and model checkpoints.

items.name: WebGuard
items.summary: Codebase, annotation toolkit, and action-level risk dataset for training and evaluating guardrail models that flag unsafe browser-agent actions before execution.

items.name: Self Operating Computer
items.summary: Framework, released in November 2023, in which a multimodal model views the screen and picks mouse and keyboard actions toward a goal, with backends such as GPT-4o, Claude 3, Gemini and LLaVA.

items.name: LiteWebAgent
items.summary: Modular web-agent framework with browser control, planning, workflow memory, and tree-search components, plus web and extension interfaces.

items.name: GUI Grounding Evaluation Harness
items.summary: ScreenSpot-Pro evaluation harness with explicit coordinate transforms, prompt and crop-based inference comparisons, and per-sample grounding accuracy and cost records.

items.name: Agent Browser Shield
items.summary: Browser extension for filtering potentially unsafe agent input.

items.name: RCI Agent
items.summary: A MiniWoB++ agent that uses explicit and implicit recursive criticism-and-improvement prompts to refine action plans and ground actions to browser state.

items.name: GroundGUI training and evaluation code
items.summary: Code for screenshot grounding through supervised training, teacher-guided distillation, reinforcement learning, and benchmark evaluation.

items.name: WebShop
items.summary: Simulated shopping environment for instruction-following web agents.

items.name: MobileGym
items.summary: A browser-hosted mobile-app simulator with programmable state, parameterized tasks and deterministic state-checking judges for parallel GUI-agent evaluation and online reinforcement learning.

items.name: Mobster engine
items.summary: iOS agent engine organized around an observe, decide, verify and act loop, using WebDriverAgent screen state and phone actions such as taps, typing, swipes and app switches.

items.name: InfiGUI-R1
items.summary: 3B GUI agent trained in two stages: distilling spatial reasoning from teacher models, then reinforcement learning that rewards accurate sub-goals and trains error recovery.

items.name: WebMarker
